thread:
maria: Heads up — steady rise in 503s from the embeddings streaming blackbox in ap-southeast1 over the last 30m. Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd. Spike lines up with synthetic batch at ~12:04.
kevin: Can you paste the timeseries panel or metric name?
maria: metric is `blackbox.embedding.stream_5xx_rate{region=\"ap-southeast1\"}` — see the big jump around 2037654200.
tara: Is that only synth probes or did customers hit 5xx too?
maria: Mostly synth probes but there are a couple of customer spikes (~20 rps) that coincide.
dmitri: Could be SNAT port exhaustion. Probe fleet + short TCP reconnects have bitten us before.
nisha: @dmitri any quick checks on the NAT gateways / ephemeral ports?
dmitri: checking — `nat_active_ports{gw=\"ap-southeast1-gw-1\"}` reporting ~62k (threshold 65k). Logs show ephemeral socket reuse errors and `connect: EADDRNOTAVAIL` bursts.
sre-bot: Alert fired: `blackbox_probe_5xx_rate` (region=ap-southeast1) value=3.2% — triggered at 2037654280.
kevin: If probes are exhausting SNAT we should reduce probe concurrency or switch probes to keepalive websockets instead of reconnect per check. Also reduce probe sampling rate for embeddings.
maria: Current probe config snippet:
```yaml
probe:
  type: streaming-embed
  concurrency: 50
  sample_rate: 1/s
  use_keepalive: false
  payload_size: 1024
```
I propose trying: `concurrency: 10`, `sample_rate: 0.2/s`, `use_keepalive: true`.
tara: That reduces visibility into cold-start GPU behavior — we use high concurrency to surface priming problems.
nisha: Alternative: route embedding probes to a warm-only probe pool (tag `probe-warm`) that keeps KV cache primed but doesn't share SNAT with prod pool.
dmitri: We can spin 2 `probe-warm` instances in ap-southeast1 on preemptible GPUs. Estimated cost delta ~ $50/day. Better than impacting prod customers.
kevin: Also need to stop alert flapping. Proposal: change `for` from `1m` to `8m` on `blackbox_probe_5xx_rate` + add `job=\"blackbox_probe\"` label and `region=~\"ap-s.*\"` to scope.
maria: Agreed. And we should split probe errors from customer SLOs in dashboards — right now probe + prod are mixed in the SLO panels.
tara: Can we add a derived SLO metric that subtracts probe noise? e.g. `effective_prod_5xx = prod_5xx - probe_5xx * probe_weight` so SLOs aren't contaminated.
kevin: Sketch query for dashboard:
```
prod_5xx_rate - (probe_5xx_rate * scalar(0.1))
```
where `0.1` is probe weight based on traffic proportion.
nisha: I'll open a PR to update probe config, add runbook notes, and tag tests. Assigning to myself: ISSUE-1234. PR will include the new keepalive + reduced concurrency values.
maria: Action items:
- nisha: reduce probe concurrency, open PR and runbook edits (ISSUE-1234)
- kevin: change alert `for` and add labels to reduce flapping
- dmitri: spin up `probe-warm` preemptible instances in ap-southeast1
- tara: update SLO dashboard to separate probe vs prod and add the derived metric
I'll watch the panel for 1h and report back. :thumbsup:
dmitri: starting probe-warm spin-up now (holding on image pull). ETA ~7m.
kevin: I'll patch the alert rule in `alerts/prometheus/blackbox.rules` in ~10m and post the diff.
nisha: PR opened: https://git.redwood/example/PR/456 — changeset includes YAML + runbook snippet.
maria: Thanks all. If we still see 5xx after probe-warm live we'll revert probe-sampling further. Closing loop later.
kevin: noted, will also add an annotation in Grafana for the probe-warm rollout so we can correlate.
